review_type: Independent saved-artifact numeric audit; no new model/API inference or human validation

overlap_check.interpretation: Recovery composite is overlapping sensitivity analysis, not independent replication.

limitations: Only strictly parseable completed source outputs are selected; failed/truncated/formatted alternatives are excluded, creating selection and survivorship limitations.
Hinted-switch curves condition on observed switching and unhinted curves use a different question mixture; their gap is not a randomized causal comparison.
The probe predicts sampled final answer letters from pre-reasoning prompts, which already contain hint/option information; decodability is not a settled decision or dishonesty.
All 28 layers are evaluated without best-layer selection. Six test questions and one shuffled-label control limit generalization; multiple layer/subgroup inspections are exploratory.

Bootstrap intervals resample questions but are conditional on the fixed training fit and selected cohort; they omit model-training and generation uncertainty. A 25% uniform baseline is not a complete task-specific chance model.
Float32 NPZ storage contains activations computed in float16; casting does not restore lost precision. No independent GPU forward-pass reproduction was performed.

Local scikit-learn 1.8.0 and SciPy 1.16.3 match recorded versions. Local Python/platform/Torch differ. Original runtime distribution listing includes both NumPy 1.26.4 and 2.2.6 without an imported NumPy version. Root reports a same-runtime post-execution import check at 04:18 UTC returned NumPy 2.2.6 and scikit-learn 1.8.0, with no intervening dependency installation; this corroborates but does not rewrite original provenance. Local refits use NumPy 2.2.6.
Artifacts do not contain fitted scaler/probe coefficients; this audit refits the frozen estimator recipe from saved activations and verifies predictions instead.
